# Collapsible

A single show/hide region controlled by a trigger with aria-expanded. Use Accordion for several related sections.

## Design tokens

This component sets no token-backed styles of its own; it inherits them from its children.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `collapsible.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library. Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
